data.description: Elevation allows elements to be lifted from the background. It can be defined by applying drop shadows or other visual cues, such as color and borders

shadows.description: Elevation using shadows reflects a spatial relationship by indicating separation from the background or allowing content to be scrolled under another element.

levels.name: Encore Overlay Box Shadow
levels.description: 30% black opacity / Blur: 12 / Offset Y: 4 - Used for elevated overlay containers and dropdowns

levels.name: Encore Overlay Drop Shadow
levels.description: 30% black opacity / Blur: 6 / Offset Y: 4 - Used for filter drop shadows on overlay components

levels.name: Activation Tooltip Shadow
levels.description: 30% black opacity / Blur: 40 / Offset Y: 4 - Used for activation tooltips with stronger emphasis

levels.name: Generic Tooltip Shadow
levels.description: 30% black opacity on first shadow / Blur: 24, Offset Y: 16; 20% black opacity on second shadow / Blur: 8, Offset Y: 6 - Composite shadow for tooltips
